items.title: 61426_Jacques Butler oral history interview
items.q: So, the band, I think the leader of the band was -- I think it was Andy Shorter brothers...

ctx.x: Well, I went to Montreal to see what was happening for a week or two and there was a place called Rockheads,... Mountain Street, / and they had a band at that time. They always had bands though, and they used American talent. Singles, and all the fellows in the band, they were ex-Americans, most of them, they had children with Canadians.

So, the band, I think the leader of the band was -- I think it was Andy Shorter brothers, they had a pianist his name was Benny and they had the two brothers, alto and tenor, and a boy named Jimmy Jones on the trumpet. Very good trumpet.

So, I luckily, I walked in one Sunday afternoon and played a solo and they wanted to know who I was. I gave him my card and he asked me how long I was staying and I said, well, I can stay here for a week.
